title: Where is it?
summary: Say exactly where something is: in front of, behind, next to, between, above, under, on and opposite.
intro: Words like أَمَامَ (in front of), خَلْفَ (behind) and بِجَانِبِ (next to) tell you where things are. They come straight before a noun, and that noun takes the ending -i: خَلْفَ الْبَنْكِ (behind the bank). In everyday speech the -i is often dropped at the end of a sentence, but today you will always see it written after these words.
objectives: Use eight words of place: أَمَامَ, خَلْفَ, بِجَانِبِ, بَيْنَ, فَوْقَ, تَحْتَ, عَلَى, مُقَابِلَ
Ask and answer 'where is…?' about buildings in town
Add the -i ending to the noun after a word of place
Say which floor something is on

realLife.title: A parcel for Emma
realLife.story: Daniel has bought a book about the pyramids for his sister Emma in Chicago, and he wants to post it before her birthday. He knows there is a post office near the school, but where exactly? Mr Karim describes the way, and at the post office a guard sends him upstairs.

sentences.en: The post office is behind the bank.
sentences.literal: office (of) the post (is) behind the bank

mistakes.why: A noun after a word of place takes the ending -i: khalfa l-banki.

sentences.en: The post office is between the café and the pharmacy.
sentences.literal: office (of) the post (is) between the café and the pharmacy

sentences.en: The book is on the table.

mistakes.why: fī means in or inside. For on top of something, use ʿalā.

sentences.en: The bag is under the chair.
The mosque is opposite the school.
The parcels office is on the second floor.
sentences.literal: office (of) the parcels (is) in the floor the second

dialogue.title: Where is the post office?
dialogue.culture: In Egypt, as in Britain, the floor at street level is the ground floor, so الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي (the second floor) is two floors up. Egyptian post offices do much more than post letters: people also pay bills and save money there.

lines.ar: يَا أُسْتَاذ كَرِيم، عِنْدِي هَدِيَّة لِأُخْتِي إِيمَا. أَيْنَ مَكْتَبُ الْبَرِيد، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
lines.en: Mr Karim, I have a present for my sister Emma. Where is the post office, please?

lines.ar: مَكْتَبُ الْبَرِيد قَرِيب جِدًّا مِنَ الْمَدْرَسَة. هُوَ خَلْفَ الْبَنْكِ.
lines.en: The post office is very close to the school. It is behind the bank.

lines.ar: خَلْفَ الْبَنْكِ؟ تَقْصِدُ الْبَنْكَ الْكَبِيرَ بِجَانِبِ الْمَدْرَسَةِ؟
lines.en: Behind the bank? You mean the big bank next to the school?

lines.ar: نَعَم، بِالضَّبْط! الْبَنْك بِجَانِبِ الْمَدْرَسَةِ، وَمَكْتَبُ الْبَرِيد خَلْفَهُ مُبَاشَرَةً.
lines.en: Yes, exactly! The bank is next to the school, and the post office is right behind it.

lines.ar: وَكَيْفَ أَعْرِفُ الْبِنَايَة؟ هَلْ هِيَ كَبِيرَة أَمْ صَغِيرَة؟
lines.en: And how will I recognise the building? Is it big or small?

lines.ar: هِيَ بِنَايَة صَفْرَاء قَدِيمَة بَيْنَ الْمَقْهَى الصَّغِيرِ وَالصَّيْدَلِيَّةِ، وَفَوْقَ الْبَابِ لَافِتَة زَرْقَاء.
lines.en: It is an old yellow building between the little café and the pharmacy, and there is a blue sign above the door.

lines.ar: صَفْرَاء، بَيْنَ الْمَقْهَى وَالصَّيْدَلِيَّةِ، وَاللَّافِتَة فَوْقَ الْبَابِ. فَهِمْتُ، شُكْرًا!
lines.en: Yellow, between the café and the pharmacy, with the sign above the door. Got it, thanks!

lines.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ! أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُرْسِلَ هٰذَا الطَّرْدَ إِلَى أَمْرِيكَا، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
lines.en: Hello! I would like to send this parcel to America, please.

lines.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ! الطُّرُود فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي، فَوْقَنَا مُبَاشَرَةً.
lines.en: And peace be upon you! Parcels are on the second floor, right above us.

lines.ar: فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي؟ وَأَيْنَ الدَّرَج؟ هَلْ هُنَاكَ مِصْعَد أَيْضًا؟
lines.en: On the second floor? And where are the stairs? Is there a lift as well?

lines.ar: الدَّرَج خَلْفَكَ، بِجَانِبِ الْبَابِ. الْمِصْعَد لَا يَعْمَلُ الْيَوْم، لِلْأَسَف.
lines.en: The stairs are behind you, next to the door. The lift isn't working today, unfortunately.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر! هٰذَا طَرْد لِأُخْتِي فِي شِيكَاغُو، وَفِيهِ كِتَاب عَنِ الْأَهْرَام.
lines.en: Good evening! This is a parcel for my sister in Chicago, and there is a book about the pyramids in it.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ النُّور! ضَعِ الطَّرْدَ عَلَى الْمِيزَانِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ… الْوَزْن كِيلُو وَاحِد.
lines.en: Good evening! Put the parcel on the scales, please… The weight is one kilo.

lines.ar: وَمَتَى يَصِلُ الطَّرْد إِلَى أَمْرِيكَا؟ عِيدُ مِيلَادِ إِيمَا بَعْدَ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّام.
lines.en: And when will the parcel arrive in America? Emma's birthday is in ten days.

lines.ar: يَصِلُ بَعْدَ أُسْبُوع تَقْرِيبًا. لَا تَقْلَقْ، الْهَدِيَّة تَصِلُ قَبْلَ عِيدِ الْمِيلَاد.
lines.en: It arrives in about a week. Don't worry, the present will arrive before the birthday.

reading.title: Daniel draws a map
reading.ar: الْمَدْرَسَة فِي شَارِع صَغِير. بِجَانِبِ الْمَدْرَسَةِ بَنْك، وَخَلْفَ الْبَنْكِ مَكْتَبُ الْبَرِيد. الْمَسْجِد مُقَابِلَ الْمَدْرَسَةِ. مَكْتَبُ الْبَرِيد بَيْنَ الْمَقْهَى وَالصَّيْدَلِيَّةِ، وَالطُّرُود فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي.
reading.en: The school is on a small street. Next to the school there is a bank, and behind the bank is the post office. The mosque is opposite the school. The post office is between the café and the pharmacy, and parcels are on the second floor.

quiz.prompt: Fill the gap: 'The book is on the table.'
Which ending does the noun take after a word of place like فَوْقَ?
In the dialogue, where is the post office?
On which floor are the parcels?
Which word has the rough sound of the ch in Scottish 'loch'?

completion: Brilliant! You can say exactly where things are, and Emma's present is on its way.
